description: Airport Runways is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. The Airport Runways database is a geographic dataset of runways in the State of Maryland containing information on the physical characteristics of the runways. The 6716 runways in the dataset are runways associated with the 19721 airports in the companion airport data set. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are airport data, aeronautical data, data product, system resource, resource aeronautical. The table has 20 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
